name: Kettlebell Front Squat
steps: Clean two kettlebells into the front rack position with your wrists straight, elbows tucked tight in front of your ribs, and feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, keep your chest upright, and sit down between your hips by bending your hips and knees together.
Descend only as far as you can keep your heels down, the bells steady and your back braced.
Drive forcefully through your midfoot and heels to stand straight back up to the starting position.
tips: Keep your upper back tight and elbows elevated slightly so the kettlebells do not pull your torso forward.
Push your knees out in line with your toes throughout the squat.
